comparison_rule.decision: first unequal stable completion or full-order volume decides; equal loading uses count/mass Pareto then height/envelope Pareto; report opposing lower-priority costs separately
comparison_rule.all_missing_or_invalid: not zero or a strategy loss; retain full denominator

endpoints.NA: empty height/envelope, missing costs/features/intervals kept typed NA/UNKNOWN/NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_RUN; never fake zero

exploratory: E1/T1 same-evidence representation with unequal information
historical JN4/JN5 appended only, not pooled with new route

aggregation.repeat: within task+method first, preserve full per-repeat outcomes; never pick best
aggregation.source: equal weights audited independent source or material groups; tasks/repeats within group summarized first
aggregation.method: do not average across old v2/v3 mixed protocol histories

missing_and_sensitivity.technical_pair: invalid for primary benefit rank; retain observed stop-before metrics as diagnostics
missing_and_sensitivity.valid_pair_mean: label conditional-on-valid subset; report missing fraction
missing_and_sensitivity.bounds: for missing primary volume ratio use [0,1] logical range only, derive worst/best paired bounds without relabeling missing as observed zero
missing_and_sensitivity.unknown_send_calls: known_calls + unknown_sends interval; usage and cost UNKNOWN for unavailable parts

retrieval_metrics.unit: state-card applicability and action-role relation, not terminal winner
retrieval_metrics.precision: true_applicable_accepts / all adjudicated known-label accepts; if zero denominator NA; UNKNOWN accepts separate
retrieval_metrics.recall: true_applicable_accepts / all known applicable state-card cases; zero denominator NA
retrieval_metrics.label_review: two independent signed human judgements using public state/pool/card only; preserve disagreement, no retriever scores or terminal results

local.unit: same public state/pool; retained normalized exact actions, common no-memory suffix strategy
local.partial_condition: unretained or missing action has no outcome delta; record NOT_RUN
local.noncausal: deletion leaves facts that may imply direction; stochastic suffix differs; no pure single-property causal claim

uncertainty.small_or_shared_source: CI/power NOT_ESTIMATED; empirical ranges not CI; no significance/generalization claim
uncertainty.upgrade_rule: Not enabled in this version. New independently reviewed and versioned analysis contract must freeze independent-source sample size, N/R, confidence level, intervals, multiplicity and practical effect BEFORE evaluating any new outcome.
uncertainty.not_permitted: request-level or adjacent-state iid CI; post-hoc new primary; seed picking

cost_latency.cost: actual invoice or authoritative metering only; unknown stays UNKNOWN, no price-table fabricated bill
cost_latency.latency: pool raw samples before quantiles; no averaging job p95 or adding nested timings

claim_ladder.overall: only preregistered positive E1/N or T1/N supports observed net gain
claim_ladder.no_positive: negative/null result valid completion; engineering/qualification != efficacy
